task_description.overview: Establish a real-time connection to a SeedLink server to receive seismic waveform data.
steps: Define a data handler function that processes incoming Trace objects.
Call create_client(server_url, on_data=data_handler) to instantiate the client and connect immediately.
Optionally define on_close and on_error callbacks to handle disconnection and errors.

task_definition.agent_prompt: Connect to the SeedLink server at {server_url} using the `from obspy.clients.seedlink.easyseedlink import create_client` function. Provide the on_data callback to handle incoming Trace objects by printing or storing them. Return the connected client instance. Call the client.get_info('{get_info}') method to get the information of the server. Save the returned xml information
